title: Hallway Echo
style: Klezmer with brisk danced-up bounce, clarinet lead over violin bends and accordion push-pull; verses stay light on bass and snare taps, pre-chorus tightens with claps and rising fiddle runs, chorus bursts open with tambourine, handclaps, and a bright clarinet hook. Lead vocal is playful and close-mic with quick doubles on key lines, gang shouts on the refrain, cheeky ad-libs between phrases. Little glissando turns, roomy claps, and a pickup clarinet flourish into each chorus; warm, vivid, and celebratory., klezmer, joyful
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I step in with my shoes so clean
The hall gives back what I mean
One little laugh, it runs away
Curls on the wall, then comes to play

[Verse 2]
My name goes out, comes back in tune
Bouncing off the ceiling moon
A coat on the hook starts swaying slow
Like it heard a joke it wants to know

[Pre-Chorus]
Hush now, listen
It's answering me
Round and round
Like a joyful key

[Chorus]
Hallway echo, echo
Call me back, call me back
Hallway echo, echo
Spin it round the track
Ha-ha-hallway echo (echo)
You make the whole house clap

[Verse 3]
Grandpa taps out with his cane
The corridor learns that game
I sing one word, it comes in three
Like it saved a seat for me

[Pre-Chorus]
Hush now, listen
It's answering me
Round and round
Like a joyful key

[Chorus]
Hallway echo, echo
Call me back, call me back
Hallway echo, echo
Spin it round the track
Ha-ha-hallway echo (echo)
You make the whole house clap

[Bridge]
Oh, let it bounce from door to door
Past the rug, back to the floor
Every laugh gets dressed in gold
Every small sound grows bold

[Chorus]
Hallway echo, echo
Call me back, call me back
Hallway echo, echo
Spin it round the track
Ha-ha-hallway echo (echo)
You make the whole house clap
